test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: There are 8 people sitting in a circle facing the centre: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H. A is sitting to the immediate right of G and immediate left of E. Second to the right of E is C. D is sitting to the immediate left of C. F is sitting to the immediate left of G. H is the immediate neighbour of F and B. Who is sitting to the immediate right of B?
solution:
There are 8 people sitting in a circle facing the centre: **A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H**.

1. A is sitting to the immediate right of G and immediate left of E.

2. Second to the right of E is C.

3. D is sitting to the immediate left of C.

4. F is sitting to the immediate left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f5dba7d94b2cb2d4eb947a7ff6c50f206c7a042d9fcb47055e00196d76e7dd5.png] 

5. H is the immediate neighbour of F and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/492a4231843867a992407a75eb17a5b9948b6913616bb62c9b4b12c5125b3573.png] 

Clearly, H is sitting to the immediate right of B.

Hence, '**H**'
 is the correct answer.
